profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this wholesale and retail trade company has experienced an 80% growth since its baseline, driven by its specialized services in the motor vehicles and motorcycles sector. As a gazelle company, it has demonstrated rapid expansion, increasing its employee base to 18 in 2024, indicating a significant increase in its operations and market reach. Its focus on repair and trade of motor vehicles and motorcycles has likely contributed to its substantial growth, solidifying its position in the industry.
